title: Gel Slice Sample Preparation for Proteomics
author: Jennifer Gin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgj3juqn
materials: Digest the protein(s) at 37 °C Overnight in an incubator or thermocycler.
Buffers to prepare fresh: Store DTT in -20 °C and Trypsin in -80 °C . IAA is light sensitive. Store in amber tube (Fisher Scientific, Cat.#05-402-31).
After the tubes are completely dry in Step 24, add 17 µL, Buffer A then transfer to plastic autosampler vials (Agilent, Cat.#5182-0567,#5182-0564) or 96-well plate (Bio-Rad, Cat.#HSP9655).

steps.title: Water wash of gel slice
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL sterile water to the gel slice in an Eppendorf tube (Cat.# 022363204), incubate 15 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: AMBIC/ACN wash
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of 50 mM AMBIC/ACN, incubate 15 min, discard the used buffer in appropriate waste, and remove the liquid.

steps.title: AMBIC/ACN incubation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 50 mM AMBIC/ACN, incubate 20 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: Acetonitrile shrink step (first)
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL acetonitrile to fully cover the gel slice (gel will shrink and turn white), incubate 5–10 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: DTT reduction
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 10 mM DTT in 25 mM AMBIC, incubate in a 56 °C water bath for 1 h, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: IAA alkylation
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 55 mM IAA in 25 mM AMBIC, incubate in the dark at room temperature for 45 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: First AMBIC/ACN wash
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 50 mM AMBIC/ACN, incubate 15 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: Repeat AMBIC/ACN wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash step (add 50 µL 50 mM AMBIC/ACN, incubate 15 min, remove liquid).

steps.title: Acetonitrile shrink step (second)
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL acetonitrile to cover the gel slice (gel will shrink and turn white), incubate 5–10 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: Trypsin digestion on ice
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of trypsin solution (12.5 ng · mL⁻¹) in 50 mM AMBIC, incubate on ice for 30 min; the trypsin should be fully absorbed. If any liquid remains, remove excess trypsin before overnight digestion.

steps.title: Re‑hydrate with AMBIC
steps.instruction: Add enough 50 mM AMBIC to completely cover the gel slice, wait 15–20 min to ensure full re‑hydration (especially for larger pieces).

steps.title: Remove from 37 °C incubator
steps.instruction: Take the gel slice out of the 37 °C incubator or thermocycler.

steps.title: Post‑digestion AMBIC incubation
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of 50 mM AMBIC, incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Add ACN/FA extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of 50 % acetonitrile / 5 % formic acid to fully cover the gel slice.

steps.title: Shaker incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a benchtop shaker (Pipette.com, Cat.# 2231000667) at room temperature for 20 min.

steps.title: Collect first extract
steps.instruction: Collect the liquid supernatant into a clean tube.

steps.title: Repeat ACN extraction sequence
steps.instruction: Perform the following three steps once more:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL acetonitrile, incubate 5 min, then collect the liquid.
Dry the collected liquid completely in a SpeedVac (Fisher Scientific, Cat.# 07-748-13).
Add 50 µL acetonitrile, incubate 15 min, then collect the liquid into a clean tube.

steps.title: Store extracts
steps.instruction: Store the final collected extracts at –20 °C until ready for LC‑MS/MS analysis.
